description:
Vintage Promotional Wall Calendar Lot
The Travelers & Northwestern Mutual Life Insurance
Paper & Cardboard Ephemera, Circa 1950s
This estate collection features vintage 1950s promotional wall calendars and art prints issued by prominent American insurance firms, including The Travelers Insurance Company of Hartford, Connecticut, and The Northwestern Mutual Life Insurance Company. Highly regarded for their high-quality lithographic reproductions, these corporate calendars showcased classic American artwork, including Currier & Ives historical lithographs and John James Audubon wildlife plates.
Items Included:
1953 The Travelers wall calendar featuring Currier & Ives prints such as "The Home of Washington, Mount Vernon, Va." and "Morning in the Woods"
1957 The Northwestern Mutual Life Insurance Company Centennial Anniversary calendar with Audubon "Mallard Duck" artwork
Standalone illustrated botanical art sheet featuring a detailed green oak tree
Multiple rolled calendar tubes and original postal shipping tubes housed in a cardboard storage box
Condition:
Paper shows vintage toning, edge curling, foxing, and age-related wear consistent with rolled storage. Outer paper sleeves and mailing tubes display tears, fraying, tape residue, and chipping. Prints retain clear details and legible typography. Hanging metal strips and eyelets present on calendars.
***Condition Disclaimer***
This is a USED item donated to Goodwill Easter Seals of the Miami Valley.
Please see images for further detail and ask any questions you may have before making a bid.
Note: Any testing of electronics for power and/or functionality will be mentioned within the listing above ONLY if applicable.
In some instances we may not have the necessary equipment to test certain electronics therefore these will be auctioned off AS-IS with no refunds.

Up for auction is a versatile estate collection of six vintage and classic wristwatches, featuring a compelling mix of mechanical automatics, dress models, and everyday classics. This lot offers an excellent opportunity for collectors, watch enthusiasts, or resellers looking for a diverse assortment of timepieces.
Lot Details:
Seiko Sportsmatic 5 (Automatic): A classic gold-tone vintage mechanical watch featuring a round sunburst dial, applied hour markers, and a day/date window at the 3 o'clock position. Marked "Waterproof" and "Diashock 21 Jewels." Shows an authentic vintage patina on the case and dial.
Embassy by Gruen Dress Watch: An elegant rectangular gold-tone watch featuring a sleek black minimalist dial accented by a single crystal hour marker at 12 o'clock and gold hands. Paired with a wide, integrated textured gold-tone linked bracelet.
Citizen Quartz Dress Watch: A timeless tank-style rectangular wristwatch featuring a black dial with gold-tone stick markers, an elegant crown, and a distinctive multi-row checkerboard patterned gold-tone link bracelet.
Edison Quartz Military/Field Style Watch: A clean, functional silver-tone watch showcasing a white dial with prominent black Arabic numerals, inner 24-hour military time tracks in red, and luminescent hands. Fitted with a classic stainless steel stretch/expansion band.
Cartier Santos Style Fashion Watch: A striking two-tone square watch heavily inspired by the iconic Santos design, featuring a polished silver-tone case, a prominent gold-tone bezel secured with signature exposed screws, a textured guilloché dial with black Roman numerals, bright blue sword-shaped hands, and a black alligator-grain leather strap.
Timex Ladies Cocktail Watch: A delicate small-profile round two-tone ladies watch featuring a white dial with gold Arabic numerals, housed on a slender matching silver and gold-tone flexible expansion bracelet.

SHIPPING - All items ship via FedEx from our Indianapolis warehouse unless otherwise indicated in the item listing. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). We are unable to ship to APO or military addresses. Please allow 5 business days ( Monday-Friday) for your purchase to be shipped.
Please note: we no longer offer shipping to Canada.
THANK YOU for shopping with Goodwill of Central and Southern Indiana, we appreciate your business.

description: Decorative collectible featuring a pale pink polished rose quartz mineral with a metallic gold edge accentuating a natural fissure. The stone is mounted on a thick clear glass L-shaped display stand. The rose quartz has a natural unpolished surface with a gold-colored foil or leaf applied to the fissure. The display stand is clear glass and provides a modern presentation for the mineral specimen. See photos for condition.

shipping.policy:
Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

description:
Product Overview:
This collection includes assorted mineral, rock, and gemstone specimens with a variety of shapes, colors, and textures. The set features both smooth and rough samples, some labeled with small numbered stickers.

Specifications:
- Materials: Quartz, granite, marble, and other common rocks and minerals
- Colors: White, black, pink, green, brown, and more
- Weight: Approximately 5 lbs
- Labels: Some pieces have small numbered stickers

This lot contains a diverse selection of geological specimens.

shipping.policy:
Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.
